tapRegions.title: Tap-to-Turn Areas
tapRegions.preview.note: The preview matches the current reading area; tapping it never turns a page
tapRegions.range.hint: Set to 0% to turn this side off
tapRegions.narrowed: The reading area is narrow, so both sides were reduced to keep the middle free
tapRegions.scrollMode: Scroll mode has no tap-to-turn; these settings apply in page mode
tapRegions.leftForward.hint: Both sides turn to the next page; swiping, keys and other ways back are unchanged
